title: 第十九章 化劲巅峰大火真相第二十章 择日不如撞日现在就打死他
slug: 修炼一天抵十年莫欺老年穷
lines: 清异局。
津沽分局。
局长周江脸色阴沉，直接将一个精美瓷杯摔得粉碎，脚步来回走动。
“废物！”
“赵玲珑、王风什么时候死的？为什么死？到现在你们也查不出来，简直是废物！”
“一直以来，只有我们清异局找其他人的麻烦，其他人什么时候能找清异局麻烦？”
“今天是老鼠把猫咬了，你们说，你们是不是废物？”
房间内，一群人脸色难看，低下头来。
突然，其中一人名叫楚青，牙关一咬，道：“局长，我们查过赵玲珑、王风尸体上的痕迹，那不是秘武打出来的，那是传武的劲力打出的痕迹，这种伤势我在刘峰、张杰几人的身上仔细对比过，相似度极高，很可能也是那个老将打出来的！”
“对，局长，之前赵玲珑、王风就一直在追查仁义堂堂主死亡的事，这几人身上的伤势都是大差不差，多半就是那个老将。”
旁边一人赵三元，开口说道。
“局长，把那老将直接抓过来，试探一下不就知道了。”
第三位人影陈安，开口说道。
“老将？”
周江脸色阴沉，眸子中阴冷闪动。
却在这时。
突然！
分局之外传来脚步声音。
紧跟着一道雄厚声音响起。
“周局长，赵玲珑、王风之死，在下也曾听说，这件事不如交给我们解决怎么样？”
众人纷纷回头，目光看去。
只见一共四位身穿宽松练武服的人影，从外面走来。
尤其为首之人。
四十多岁，目光犀利，似乎久居高位，不怒自威。
不少人顿时忍不住脸色变幻，下意识低下头去。
天下武会，津沽分会的会长！
唐云鹤！
也怪不得这些人不敢抬头正眼相看。
天下秘武高手，有七成都是出自天下武会。
剩下三成，则是出自其他家族、势力。
他们这些低头的人，基本上都是天下武会培养出来的人才，后来才进入的清异局。
所以面对天下武会分会长，那就跟见到自家师叔、师伯一样，只能低头行礼。
周江却发出一道冷哼，阴阳道：“呦，今儿什么风，把唐会长给吹来了？”
他手底之人，有一半都是出自天下武会。
他这位分局长，心中能开心才叫怪了。
到底我是局长，还是你是局长啊？
“周局长，何必如此打趣在下？”
唐云鹤轻轻一叹，道，“在下是永远不会和周局长争权夺利的，咱们说到底是同一个船上的人，我们都是秘武高手，今后少不得还要在一起相互切磋，相互印证。”
“你们来这里什么事？”
周江出口询问。
content_en:
Clear the strange situation.
Jingu Branch.
Chang Zhoujiang's face was gloomy, he smashed a delicate porcelain cup to pieces, and walked back and forth.
"Trash!"
"When did Zhao Linglong and Wang Feng die? Why did they die? You can't find out until now. They are just trash!"
"For a long time, only our Qingyi Bureau has caused trouble for others. When will others cause trouble for the Qingyi Bureau?"
"The mouse bit the cat today. Do you think you are useless?"
In the room, a group of people looked ugly and lowered their heads.
Suddenly, one of them, named Chu Qing, gritted his teeth and said: "Director, we have checked the marks on the bodies of Zhao Linglong and Wang Feng. They were not caused by secret martial arts, but marks made by the power of Chuanwu. I have carefully compared the injuries on Liu Feng and Zhang Jie. They are very similar. It was probably caused by the veteran!"
"Yes, Director. Zhao Linglong and Wang Feng have been investigating the death of the leader of Renyi Hall before. The injuries on these people are all about the same. They are probably the veteran."
The person next to him, Zhao Sanyuan, said.
"Director, just grab that veteran and test him, and you'll find out."
The third figure, Chen An, spoke.
"Veteran?"
Zhou Jiang's face was gloomy, and his eyes flashed coldly.
But at this moment.
Sudden!
There was the sound of footsteps outside the precinct.
Then a strong voice sounded.
"Director Zhou, I have heard about the deaths of Zhao Linglong and Wang Feng. How about leaving this matter to us?"
Everyone turned around and looked around.
I saw a total of four figures wearing loose martial arts uniforms walking from outside.
Especially the leader.
He is in his forties, has sharp eyes, seems to have been in a high position for a long time, and is not angry or powerful.
Many people couldn't help but their faces suddenly changed, and they lowered their heads subconsciously.
President of Tianxia Martial Arts Association, Jingu branch!
Tang Yunhe!
No wonder these people didn't dare to look up and look at each other.
Seventy percent of the world's secret martial arts masters come from the World Martial Arts Association.
The remaining 30% came from other families and forces.
These people who bow their heads are basically talents trained by the World Martial Arts Association, and they only entered the Qingyi Bureau later.
Therefore, when facing the branch president of the World Martial Arts Association, it is just like meeting your own master or uncle. You can only bow your head and salute.
But Zhou Jiang let out a cold snort and said yin and yang: "Hey, what kind of wind has brought President Tang here today?"
Half of the people under his control are from the Tianxia Martial Arts Association.
It's weird for him, the branch chief, to be happy.
Am I the director, or are you the director?
"Director Zhou, why are you teasing me like this?"
Tang Yunhe sighed softly and said, "I will never compete with Director Zhou for power. After all, we are on the same boat. We are all secret martial arts masters. From now on, we will inevitably have to learn from each other and prove each other."
"What are you doing here?"
Zhou Jiang exited and asked.
